Metadata.title: Lucas Portela
Metadata.description: Personal site of Lucas Portela, a Computer Science student in Maceió.

Home.name: portelav
Home.headline: I'm Lucas Portela, and I've already built a few <accent>websites that are live</accent>.
Home.lead: I study Computer Science in Maceió, Brazil. I'm looking for a development internship, and I build sites for people who need one.

landing.name: Dra. Thaiane Lessa
landing.what: A page for a dental surgeon in Maceió that introduces her and takes visitors to WhatsApp.
landing.part: All of it, from design to code, made for phones first.
landing.decision: No patients, no before and after and no promised results, because of the Brazilian dental council's advertising rules.

draftcs.alt: First screen of DraftCS: the call “Monte o time invencível”.
draftcs.name: DraftCS
draftcs.what: You draw a real Counter-Strike Major roster, pick five players and simulate the run for the title.
draftcs.part: Curating player, roster and country data, scrolling in the simulator on phones and the area for sharing a result.

crewz.alt: First screen of Crewz: the line “Encontre quem quer fazer o que você quer fazer”.
crewz.name: Crewz
crewz.what: A social network for finding people who want to do what you want to do.
crewz.part: Design system, visual redesign, onboarding, profile, direct messages and search.

About.title: About
About.text: I started in Law and left because I couldn't see myself working in it. Now I study Computer Science at Afya UNIMA and I'm learning to build software with AI.
About.repo: This site's code is public, with its decisions on record in the <link>repository</link>.
About.photoAlt: Illustration of Lucas Portela, smiling, with a beard and a black T-shirt.

Hire.title: Need a site?
Hire.lead: I build the page for your business from design to code, made for phones first, with a direct path to your WhatsApp.
Hire.step1: You tell me what you need.
Hire.step2: We agree on scope and deadline in writing.
Hire.step3: You follow along through a preview link.
